newsitem.title: USA: Moog Q2 US profits jump, Int'l profits off.
newsitem.headline: Moog Q2 US profits jump, Int'l profits off.

text.p: Moog Inc on Tuesday said second quarter U.S. profits rose by 30 percent against the previous year, while international profits fell by 29 percent.
Earlier, the firm reported a second quarter profit of $3.3 million, or $0.45 per share, compared with earnings of $3.0 million, or $0.40 per share in the same quarter a year ago.
The company had fewer shares outstanding this year.
Moog said higher U.S. sales volume and a favorable product mix improved margins in the commercial airplane business. The acquisition of Moog Controls also provided an earnings boost.
Level International sales were affected by the strength of the U.S. dollar, Moog said.
Increased production rates in the company's commercial aircraft sector offset expected declines in military aircraft revenues, the company said.
Moog added that growth in its incoming orders for satellites, industrial hydraulics and entertainment simulation will also add to revenues this year.
Moog is a worldwide manufacturer of precision control components and systems.
